#!/usr/bin/python
import os, socket
base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
path = os.path.join(base, 'run/status.sock')
if os.path.exists(path):
    os.unlink(path)
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.bind(path)
os.chmod(path, 438)
s.listen(5)
while True:
    c, address = s.accept()
    c.recv(1024)
    c.sendall(open(os.path.join(base, 'status.txt'), 'rb').read())
    c.close()

import os
import socket

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

STATUS_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, 'status.txt')
MAX_REQUEST = 1024

if os.path.exists(SOCKET_PATH):

old_umask = os.umask(0007)
try:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    server.bind(SOCKET_PATH)
finally:
    os.umask(old_umask)
os.chmod(SOCKET_PATH, 0660)
server.listen(16)

while True:
    client, address = server.accept()
    try:
        request = ''
        while '\n' not in request and len(request) <= MAX_REQUEST:
            chunk = client.recv(256)
            if not chunk:
                break
            request += chunk
        if request == 'STATUS\n':
            status_file = open(STATUS_PATH, 'rb')
            try:
                response = status_file.read()
            finally:
                status_file.close()
        else:
            response = 'ERROR\n'
        client.sendall(response)
    except socket.error:
        pass
    client.close()

#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          statusd
# Required-Start:    $local_fs
# Required-Stop:     $local_fs
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Local Unix socket status service
### END INIT INFO

DAEMON=/usr/bin/python
SCRIPT=/srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary/server.py
PIDFILE=/var/run/statusd.pid
NAME=statusd

case "$1" in
  start)
    printf '%s' "Starting $NAME: "
    start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --background --make-pidfile \
      --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --chuid statusd:status-readers \
      --exec "$DAEMON" -- "$SCRIPT"
    result=$?
    [ "$result" -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$NAME." || printf '%s\n' 'failed.'
    exit "$result"
    ;;
  stop)
    printf '%s' "Stopping $NAME: "
    start-stop-daemon --stop --quiet --oknodo --retry TERM/5/KILL/5 \
      --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --exec "$DAEMON"
    result=$?
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    [ "$result" -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$NAME." || printf '%s\n' 'failed.'
    exit "$result"
    ;;
  restart|force-reload)
    "$0" stop
    "$0" start
    ;;
  status)
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf '%s\n' "$NAME is running."
      exit 0
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$NAME is not running."
    exit 3
    ;;
  *)
    printf '%s\n' "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|force-reload|status}"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
STATUSD_INIT
